# Markdown

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/markdown` (default export). Primitive markdown text rendered to HTML in read formats (re-exported from card-api). Review bodies in this realm use it.

## Usage
```ts
import MarkdownField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/markdown';
```

Example: value `"**State:** Next → Done — spec verified"`
